trend_bank.name: Catchphrase on the beat
trend_bank.where: TikTok ('signature line' trend, Dec 2025, likely back this December)
trend_bank.use: Each brother stares at the camera with a deadpan face while our own beat builds; on the drop he shouts his catchphrase with a big pose (Big Bro: arms out wide, Little Bro: double thumbs up), then they swap and say each other's line. 8 to 12 second Short, a fun way to teach kids the characters.

trend_bank.name: Blinking lights alphabet
trend_bank.where: TikTok December 2025 (Christmas lights alphabet wall, no show reference needed)
trend_bank.use: A wall of coloured holiday lights with letters painted under them; in our own alphabet or spelling song the lights blink one letter at a time to spell short winter words (S N O W, H A T) while the brothers point and sing each letter. Works as a learning Short and a long December song.

trend_bank.name: Frozen bubble science
trend_bank.where: TikTok and parenting sites every winter (frozen bubbles revival, Feb 2026)
trend_bank.use: Little Bro blows a bubble outside in the snow, the music slows and the bubble freezes into sparkly ice feathers in close up, then Big Bro taps it and it shatters into snowflakes for the chorus. Meshy steps: standing, blowing with hands cupped at the mouth, slow wide eyed lean forward, then a happy jump and arms raised for the snowflake burst.

trend_bank.name: Then and now growth carousel
trend_bank.where: TikTok photo carousel (childhood photo then present day, nearly 9M views in weeks, Fast Company 10 Nov 2026)
trend_bank.use: Slide or clip one shows baby Big Bro and baby Little Bro doing something (stacking blocks, a tiny wobble dance), slide two shows them now doing the same thing bigger and better, with our own gentle 'look how big we grew' song line on each cut. Works as a Short, a Reel carousel and a New Year 'this year we learned' recap.

trend_bank.name: Wrong seat gag
trend_bank.where: TikTok ('first time in a fancy cafe', Epidemic Sound 13 Nov 2026)
trend_bank.use: Little Bro proudly sits on something that is not a seat (a drum, a giant gift box, a snowman's lap) while Big Bro sits on the real chair; the music stops, both look at the camera, then they laugh and swap. Short of 10 to 15 seconds with our own silly sting, standing only for the dance part.

trend_bank.name: Dance till you flop
trend_bank.where: TikTok ('out of breath' dance challenge, top clips 10M+ views, families join in)
trend_bank.use: End any high energy Bro Bros song by dancing faster and faster, then both brothers freeze in a wobbly tired pose, puff their cheeks and give a thumbs up. Meshy steps: standing in place, fast jogging on the spot, arms pumping, big jumping jack twice, then a slow wobble with arms hanging loose and one tired thumbs up. No lying down.

trend_bank.name: Synced duo routine
trend_bank.where: TikTok (Ba Ba Ba dance, No. 1 by new videos per day on 13 Nov 2026, ViralRemix chart)
trend_bank.use: Big Bro and Little Bro side by side do the same short routine perfectly in sync to our own bouncy song, then a playful mistake by Little Bro and a laugh. Meshy steps: standing in place, two claps, step right and left, roll arms forward twice, point to the camera together, small hop with both feet, end with a high five.

trend_bank.name: Go, Go, Go rush
trend_bank.where: TikTok (frantic 'go, go, go' lip sync for everyday rush moments, NewEngen 13 Nov 2026)
trend_bank.use: Morning rush Short with our own chant song: the Bros race to get ready (shoes, coat, hat, bag) as our 'Go, go, go!' hook speeds up each round, then a big calm freeze and 'We made it!'. Meshy steps: standing in place, run fast on the spot pumping arms, quick reach up with both arms, quick reach down to knees without bending low, then freeze with arms out.

trend_bank.name: Say the same word
trend_bank.where: TikTok (two people name items in a category until they match, a lap for every miss; HeyOrca week of 11 Nov 2026)
trend_bank.use: Game song Short: Big Bro and Little Bro pick a category (fruits, animals, colours), count 'one, two, three' and shout a word together; if the words differ, both run a lap in place to the beat while the chorus sings 'Run, run, run around!', and when they finally match they jump and high five. Meshy steps: standing, run on the spot pumping arms for 4 beats, then a small jump in place with both arms up and a high five.

trend_bank.name: Family line dance
trend_bank.where: TikTok (Baby Doll line dance with family or crew, 13 Nov 2026 chart)
trend_bank.use: The Bros, friends and grown up characters stand in two rows and do a simple country style line dance to our own song so whole families can copy at home. Meshy steps: standing, step touch right, step touch left, two heel taps forward, clap, quarter turn to the right, repeat.

trend_bank.name: Slow motion entrance
trend_bank.where: TikTok ('Pray For Me' slow motion group entrances, NewEngen 13 Nov 2026)
trend_bank.use: Song intro with our own big drum build: a wide, steady shot of the playground; Big Bro glides in slowly from the left, Little Bro from the right, then each animal friend from behind, all in slow motion with funny 'serious' faces, and on the beat drop everyone snaps to normal speed and starts the chorus dance. Meshy steps: standing, slow walk forward with arms swinging gently, stop, cross arms with a serious face, then on the drop jump in place with both arms up.

trend_bank.name: Tutorial turns into a dance
trend_bank.where: TikTok ('how to' bait and switch dance, NewEngen Dec 2025, likely back in Dec 2026)
trend_bank.use: Big Bro starts a serious 'How to wrap a present' (or 'how to build a snowman') tutorial, step one, step two, then our own song kicks in and the steps become a dance; ends with the present wrapped. Meshy steps: standing, fold arms forward twice like folding paper, turn hands in a rolling motion, clap, then bounce side to side.

trend_bank.name: Year in songs recap
trend_bank.where: Reels and TikTok every Wrapped week (Spotify Wrapped expected about Wed 2 Dec 2026; past drops 3 Dec 2025, 4 Dec 2024)
trend_bank.use: A 'Bro Bros Wrapped' Reel: a countdown of our top 5 songs of the year (5 to 1), two seconds of each chorus with a big number card, the Bros cheering at No. 1, then 'Which was YOUR favourite?' for parents to answer. Uses only our own songs.
